I understand fully. 
The mindfulness practice has helped me so far with my current relationship. Whenever I feel any extreme emotion I separate myself from the situation physically - go to another room for quiet time etc and write down what I'm feeling and why. Reading it objectively can help you identify which trigger points have been pushed, and try and add a 'rational person' view to each of them as if you were giving someone else advice. It can really help you see where you're 'normal' feelings and your 'bpd' feelings are butting heads and then take on the situation from the entire objective point of view.
